cohort: The study included all live births at Hotel-Dieu de France University Hospital, a tertiary referral center in Beirut, Lebanon, from January 1, 2018, to September 30, 2020.
finding: The overall cesarean section rate was 56.8%, with Robson groups 5, 2, and 10 contributing most significantly, and a decrease in CS rate was observed in 2020 for women admitted for induction of labor (groups 2 and 4) due to policy changes and the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: A decrease in cesarean section rate was noted in 2020 among women admitted for induction of labor (groups 2 and 4) following the implementation of new department policies and the restrictions caused by the coronavirus disease 2019 pandemic.
